sources.title: Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users
sources.verified_finding: As of May 3, finance and insurance AI use was 33.9%; retail trade around 14%.
sources.scope: AI in any business function; not specifically generative AI or human-reviewed customer-service drafting. Finance/insurance is not banks alone; retail is not apparel ecommerce alone.
sources.limitations: Historical snapshot, not verified latest October estimate. Core question changed November 2025; comparisons spanning the change need qualification.
sources.use: Broad sector background and a challenge to assuming conservative banking means lower sector-wide adoption.
